newsitem.title: USA: General Growth Properties buys mall stake.
newsitem.headline: General Growth Properties buys mall stake.

text.p: General Growth Properties Inc said Wednesday it acquired a 50 percent stake in Town East Mall in Mesquite (Dallas), Texas, for $56.5 million.

General Growth said it bought the stake of the enclosed mall from Atlantic Freeholds II, a Nevada general partnership. The deal included $28.5 million in cash and the assumption of approximately $28 million of debt.
The property is expected to produce approximately $5 million of net operating income during the next 12 months to General Growth.
Town East Mall, which opened in 1971 and was renovated in 1986, has about 1,250,000 square feet on a 99-acre tract.

"We are excited about the long-term prospects for Town East Mall," Matthew Bucksbaum, chairman, said in a statement. "We have managed Town East for two years and have three additional malls in the greater Dallas metropolitan area, all of which are benefiting from the tremendous job and population growth in the area."
